parameters.content:
## Create a narrated video from an approved script with VideoGen

Turn approved onboarding, product, or educational narration into an editable video and download its MP4. The script is spoken verbatim; the template does not write or summarize an article.

Replace `script` with your final narration. Set `approved` to true after review. This template requests stock visuals, narration, captions, and MP4 export. No avatar or generated video clips are requested.

Requires a paid VideoGen account and API credits. Create HTTP Header Auth credentials named Authorization with value Bearer YOUR_API_KEY, and select them on both authenticated HTTP nodes. No credentials are embedded.

The start request is never automatically retried. Polling stops on failure, cancellation, unknown status, or after 15 minutes. A timeout does not cancel the remote job. Reuse the saved workflowRunId when recovering.

The last node returns the MP4 as binary data. Connect Google Drive, S3, or another storage node for durable storage; signed API URLs expire.
